title: Sweep record (v1)
description: Aggregate counts from one sweep of the TfL JamCams. One record per file at sweeps/YYYY/MM/DD/<sweep_id>.json on the data branch. Counts only: no images, boxes or coordinates of people. Rules the schema cannot express, enforced by wearreport.aggregate.check_record: sweep_id is the minute of started_at; finished_at is not before started_at; frames_ok plus every frames_failed count equals cameras_listed; persons_total and umbrellas_total are the sums over per_camera; per_camera has at most frames_ok entries. check_record is authoritative and stricter than this schema (for example on calendar dates, integer counts written as floats and trailing newlines): a consumer that must reject every invalid record uses it.

sweep_id.description: The UTC minute the sweep started, YYYYMMDDTHHMMZ.

cameras_listed.description: Cameras the registry listed as available, each fetched once.

frames_ok.description: Frames fetched, decoded and run through the detector.

frames_failed.description: Frames that failed, by error category: timeout, http (a status outside 2xx or an oversized body), decode, network, detect (the detector refused the frame or failed on it), invalid_id (a camera the registry listed with an id that cannot be published; it was not fetched). The first five are always present; invalid_id is present only when it is at least 1, and a missing category means 0.

per_camera.description: Counts per camera id, for cameras where anything was detected. Cameras with no detection and failed frames are absent.

weather.description: Conditions in central London at the forecast time step nearest started_at, or null when none was available.

model.description: The detector model the sweep loaded, e.g. yolox_m.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the model file the sweep loaded.

attribution.description: Attribution statements for the data sources this record used (AGENTS.md INV-5).
